title: SDV
summary: A personal collection of Jupyter notebooks that walk through SDV's single-table, multi-table, and sequential synthesizers, closely mirroring the official SDV documentation and tutorials. The repository directly imports and runs SDV classes such as GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, HMASynthesizer, DayZSynthesizer, and HSASynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic tabular and relational data.
evidence: SINGLE TABLE DATA/GaussianCopula.ipynb:1451 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer' and similar calls in TVAESynthesizer.ipynb, Clinical_CTGAN.ipynb, HMASynthesizer.ipynb
needs: DayZSynthesizer/HSASynthesizer are not part of public SDV API; may be proprietary/enterprise classes shown only in tutorial code, not verifiable as run successfully
